status_help: read the passage and understood it with the glosses
filled the cloze without peeking and checked the answers
can retell the story out loud in your own words, no text
level_notes: Ten story lessons, one a week, each built the same way: a short Spanish passage with the new words in amber, glosses for the hard support words, the English hidden until you want it, a five-blank cloze, and three speaking prompts. Read → do the cloze → say it out loud. The last status is 'can retell it' because that, not the reading, is the goal.

skills.name: Lesson 1 · Hola, soy Tanya
skills.what: Greetings, introducing yourself, ser and llamarse, ages, languages.
skills.goal: Introduce yourself in six sentences without notes.
skills.homework: Record your introduction on your phone; listen back once.

skills.name: Lesson 2 · Mi familia
skills.goal: Describe three family members with two adjectives each.
skills.homework: Write five sentences about your family; read them aloud.

skills.name: Lesson 3 · Un día normal
skills.what: Daily routine, regular present tense, reflexive verbs, telling the time.
skills.goal: Narrate your day from waking to bed.
skills.homework: Say your routine while doing it tomorrow morning — in Spanish, out loud.

skills.name: Lesson 4 · En la cafetería
skills.what: Ordering food and drink, quisiera, numbers and prices, paying.
skills.goal: Order a full breakfast and pay, politely, without English.
skills.homework: Order in Spanish at a real café or taquería this week.

skills.name: Lesson 5 · Perdona, ¿dónde está…?
skills.what: Asking and giving directions, estar vs hay, place words.
skills.goal: Give directions from your home to the nearest shop.
skills.homework: Describe your neighbourhood in six sentences with hay.

skills.name: Lesson 6 · De compras
skills.what: Clothes, colours, sizes, ¿cuánto cuesta?, this/that, first taste of the past.
skills.goal: Describe what you're wearing and buy something in a shop.
skills.homework: Name the colour of ten things in your room, fast.

skills.name: Lesson 7 · Me gusta el fin de semana
skills.what: Gustar and friends, hobbies, plans with voy a.
skills.goal: Say five likes, three dislikes and your weekend plans.
skills.homework: Text a friend three plans for the weekend — in Spanish.

skills.name: Lesson 8 · ¿Qué tiempo hace?
skills.what: Weather, seasons, clothes for the weather.
skills.goal: Give a 30-second weather report for today.
skills.homework: Every morning this week: one sentence about the weather, aloud.

skills.name: Lesson 9 · Ayer fue un día largo
skills.what: The preterite: regular forms and the four irregulars you can't avoid.
skills.goal: Tell what you did yesterday in eight sentences.
skills.homework: Each night: three things you did today, in the past tense.

skills.name: Lesson 10 · Planes de viaje
skills.what: Review of everything: future plans, opinions, connectors.
skills.goal: Two minutes of continuous Spanish about yourself, recorded.
skills.homework: Record the two minutes; compare with the Lesson 1 recording.

skills.name: Read every lesson aloud, twice
skills.what: Silent reading trains recognition; reading aloud trains the mouth. Both times, even when it feels silly.
skills.goal: Comfortable speed on the second read.

skills.name: Ten-minute flashcards
skills.what: Put each lesson's amber words into Anki or paper cards: Spanish on the front, English on the back. Review before adding.
skills.goal: Every target word from earlier lessons still recalled.

skills.name: Listen: Coffee Break Spanish or Dreaming Spanish
skills.what: One beginner episode a week. Don't worry about understanding everything; the ear needs volume.
skills.goal: An episode a week, ten weeks.
skills.homework: On a walk or the commute.

skills.name: Speak to a real person
skills.what: Order in Spanish, greet a neighbour, book a 30-minute italki or Tandem chat. Mistakes are the point.
skills.goal: One real exchange a week from Lesson 4 on.
skills.homework: Weekly, and note one thing you couldn't say — that's next week's vocabulary.
